findings.summary: Exact structural root/action type exclusions are rejected after graph identity is known and CLI invalid input preserves prior output.
Unsupported-boundary visibility is filter-aware and excluded regions leave only the audit fallback.
Built-in and configured hidden interactions are counted once and audit wording uses filtered evidence.
Canonical pattern validation rejects whitespace, empty segments, consecutive dots, and non-final wildcards while preserving CLR metadata characters.
Mermaid validation rejects obsolete generic control labels and legacy fixtures use meaningful labels.

Candidate checkpoint deletion and delegated workflow documentation are intentional quarantine/orchestration changes, not accepted CT-8 product semantics; no superseded candidate checkpoint claims will be published.

focusedCommand.summary: After owner-authorized repair continuation, 47 Configuration, 105 Wording, and 45 Rendering tests passed (197 total).

finalGate.summary: 47 Configuration, 105 Wording, 45 Rendering, and 19 CLI tests passed. Initial CLI failures were caused by unrestored fixture assets; after fixture restore the unchanged candidate passed all CLI tests.

notes: The original external candidate remains unchanged on a local branch. CT-8 repairs its presentation delta in place and will publish only a clean squashed tree.
Candidate documentation was removed because its execution states and verification claims were not reliable durable authority.

Seven risk-focused claims were added. Orchestrator inspection confirmed filtering is computed before participant/message construction, dedicated documentation exclusions replace misuse of selection.exclude, concise labels are retained, and generic break notes are no longer invented.
Two review-repair reruns failed and CT-8 was procedurally Blocked with the local worktree preserved.

The owner explicitly authorized autonomous continuation on 2026-08-19 despite procedural failures, with instructions to stop only when the clean integration is ready for final merge or a substantive external blocker makes completion impossible.
All independent review findings are resolved and CT-8 is closed.
